title: Balancing Relief on Replacement Tire Mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Balancing relief is taken off the line's mount-and-balance charge on the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire. It follows the line and the set's balancing records.

1. On a line that includes mounting with the adjustment credit, the whole mount-and-balance charge per tire is relieved.
2. On a line whose rotation-and-balance visit price is $0.00, for a set that carries at least one Crestline rotation-and-balance record, balancing is already part of the set's lifetime service and 40% of the mount-and-balance charge per tire is relieved.
3. Any other set has nothing relieved.

| Line | Mounting included with the credit | Rotation-and-balance visit price |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | No | $29.99 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | No | $0.00 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | No | $0.00 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | No | $0.00 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | Yes | $0.00 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | Yes | $0.00 |

Only rotation records with balancing count; rotation-only records do not. Each relief on the mounting charge is worked out on its own, and the mounting charge less every relief taken off it is never below 0.

**Cases (hypothetical sets):** a Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty set with two rotation-and-balance records — 40% of $25.00, $10.00, relieved; the same set with rotation-only records — nothing; a Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty set — nothing, its rotation-and-balance visit is priced at $29.99.
